display.purpose: Page titles and primary Awake state.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Sliding segmented thumb and switch travel.

components.name: Sliding Segmented Control
components.description: Flat monochrome segmented selector with smoothly gliding thumb and cap-centered labels.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; border-radius: 7px; background: #171717; border: 1px solid #303133; } .ds-seg-active, .ds-seg-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 26px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1; text-box-trim: trim-both; text-box-edge: cap alphabetic; } .ds-seg-active { border-radius: 5px; background: #292a2c; color: #efefed; } .ds-seg-item { color: #adaeaf; }

narrative.overview: Neutral warm graphite dark mode and cool-blue/white light mode accented solely by warm amber, with smooth sliding segmented controls, exact cap-height text centering, and instant route switching.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome neutral graphite dark theme and cool-blue/white light theme.
Warm orange-amber reserved exclusively for active state and primary actions.
Zero glass effects and zero extra accent colors.
Smooth subpixel sliding segmented control and cap-centered control labels.

rules.name: The Amber-Only Accent Rule
rules.body: Only neutral graphite, subtle cool-blue light neutrals, and warm orange-amber are used.

dos: Do keep Ember's original open layout, framed Manual hold, quiet 4-metric readout, and smooth sliding segmented controls.
donts: Don't add glass effects, green badges, or extra accent colors.
